name: TC-445: phone-booking dialog — fill party/date+time/name/phone → confirmation code; appears in the day view with the right status chip; cancel updates it
description: Owner phone bookings are always ADVISORY (mode:'staff') — no min-notice/advance-window enforcement, so any date/time works. Submitting returns a confirmationCode and refreshes the day list (shared refresh), so the row is visible without a manual reload; cancelling via the row's kebab menu PATCHes status to CANCELLED.
